title: Cowboy Casserole with Biscuits
description: This combination of hamburger, beans, and bacon over biscuits will bring out the cowboy in anyone. It has become a family favorite. It is so easy to make, and we love to make it when we’re camping.
ingredients: 2 (15 ounce) cans baked beans with pork

steps.text: Cook bacon in a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium heat until evenly browned. Drain, and cut into bite size pieces. Set aside. Add ground beef and onion to the skillet, and cook until no longer pink, and the onion is tender. Drain.

Stir bacon, baked beans and barbecue sauce into the ground beef, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low, and place biscuits in a single layer over the top of the mixture. Cover, and simmer for about 10 minutes, or until the biscuits are done. Place two biscuits on each plate, and spoon beans over.

video.description: Try this casserole that’s the ideal easy dinner whether you’re at home or in the great outdoors! In this video, Nicole shows you how to make a cowboy casserole with soft buttery biscuits. This one-pan recipe combines the delicious flavors and textures of bacon, hamburger meat, softened onions, and baked beans underneath a crumbly biscuit topping. After baking the pan in the oven until the biscuits have browned, enjoy this hearty and simple meal that can feed and please a crowd!
